result.reason: The clause adopts mutuality, limits coverage to personnel directly involved in the services, includes the required general-advertising and unsolicited-approach carve-outs, and does not prohibit hiring. However, the 12-month tail runs from expiration or termination of the Agreement rather than from the end of each employee’s involvement, potentially creating a materially longer restriction than the fallback permits. The separate hiring carve-out also substantially duplicates the definition of “Solicit,” so the revision is not fully minimal. Otherwise, unrelated commercial intent is preserved and the drafting is generally professional.
